scientific_integrity: Proof by greedy period cost, transfer matrix, nilpotent rank-one reduction, and extremal cyclic run analysis. Public source references are acknowledged. No independent audit or validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Counts distinct concatenated square subsequences only in full powers of an identical increasing permutation period. No claim for generic hosts, incomplete periods, or embedding multiplicities. The proof applies uniformly to all q>=2, k>=1; finite tests are corroborative. An earlier exact specialization may exist beyond inspected sources.
title: Square-subsequence spectra of cyclic permutation powers
